activities.text: At the start of your turn, remove all conditions affecting you and heal 4d8 HP, with no action needed.

Body of Iron|Monk.why: Once per day; from 20th (Body of Iron Made Whole) it removes every condition and heals 4d8.

Perfect Shot (Improved)|Gunslinger.why: Its second daily use is on Perfect Shot.

Master Duelist (Improved)|Swashbuckler.why: From 24th Master Duelist is once per encounter: reset its use after each encounter (one tracker, on Master Duelist).

Intelligence Bonus|Artificer.why: The weekly rate belongs to Lasting Work.

activities.name: Lasting Work
activities.text: Make a permanent item as your Kit describes: {1:once a month, 15:once a week, 20:twice a week}.

Lasting Work|Artificer.why: Once a month until 15th, once a week from 15th, twice a week from 20th: the rate changes, so it isn't tracked as uses.

activities.name: Master Duelist
activities.text: Declare a decisive strike: one melee attack that deals maximum damage if it hits (a miss still uses it). Lower-Level witnesses save or have Disadvantage on their first attack against you in later fights. From 24th level it's once per encounter: reset its use after each encounter.

Master Duelist|Swashbuckler.why: Once per day; once per encounter from 24th (Master Duelist (Improved)).

activities.name: Inspire
activities.text: The default Command, for the encounter: friendly creatures within your presence (up to {1:12, 3:25, 5:50, 7:250, 9:1000, 12:5000, 16:20000}) have Advantage on their first attack roll each round. {1:, 4:Rallying Cry: also ends Frightened and Charmed on allies within 30ft who can hear you.}

activities.name: Embolden
activities.text: For the encounter, companions and followers within {3:30ft, 19:60ft} have Advantage on Will saves. {1:, 4:Rallying Cry: also ends Frightened and Charmed on allies within 30ft who can hear you.}

activities.name: Demoralise
activities.text: For the encounter, enemies who can see you (up to {5:25, 7:100, 9:250, 12:1000, 16:5000}) have Disadvantage on Charisma checks; on a failed Will save (your Class Save DC) they also have Disadvantage on their first attack roll each round. {1:, 4:Rallying Cry: also ends Frightened and Charmed on allies within 30ft who can hear you.}

activities.name: Expert in Arms
activities.text: Until the start of your next turn, allies within {9:40ft, 19:80ft} who follow your orders have Advantage on contested manoeuvre checks. {1:, 4:Rallying Cry: also ends Frightened and Charmed on allies within 30ft who can hear you.}

Command (Charisma)|Knight.why: Books v0.10.25 (R-B7): one Command pool, 1 + Charisma modifier a day (minimum 2), +1 at 6th and 12th; each option spends one use and lasts the encounter (Expert in Arms until your next turn). Rallying Cry (4th) and Banner Bearer (19th, range doubles) ride on every Command.

activities.name: Exalt
activities.text: The default Performance, as part of your action: {1:one ally, 6:2 allies, 12:3 allies, 18:4 allies} within 60ft who can see and hear you have Advantage on attribute checks and saves (including class ability checks, not attack rolls) for the encounter.

activities.name: Discord
activities.text: A sharp jeer or discordant note: a target within 30ft makes a Will save (your Class Save DC) or has Disadvantage on its next attack roll.

activities.name: Rally
activities.text: All creatures within earshot re-save against any fear or morale effect affecting them, even if they failed before; those who succeed ignore that fear source for the rest of the encounter.

activities.name: Exhort Greatness
activities.text: Costs 2 uses. {1:One creature, 11:2 creatures, 13:3 creatures, 15:4 creatures, 17:5 creatures, 19:6 creatures, 21:7 creatures, 23:8 creatures} within 30ft who can hear you have Advantage on their first attack roll each round for the encounter, and gain temporary HP equal to two rolls of their Hit Die, adding their Constitution modifier to each roll.

activities.name: Words of Power
activities.text: Costs 2 uses. One creature makes a Will save (your Class Save DC) or is deafened until the end of its next turn. {10:, 17:From 17th Words of Power (Improved) adds more by the target's Level.}

Performance (Charisma)|Bard.why: Books v0.10.25 (R-B7): one Performance pool, Bard level + Charisma modifier a day (minimum 2), spent as part of your action once per round; Exalt and Discord from 1st, Rally 3rd, Exhort Greatness 5th (2 uses), Words of Power 10th (2 uses). Exalt reaches more allies by level (K15, v0.10.26).

activities.name: Smite
activities.text: The default Channel, spent as you attack: Advantage on that attack roll, plus +1 damage per Paladin level, against any foe regardless of alignment.

activities.name: Turn Undead
activities.text: As your action: turn undead as a Cleric 2 levels lower than your Paladin level; the Turn DC is your Class Save DC, using Charisma. Destruction from 8th effective turning level, if the undead's Level is no more than half that level.

activities.name: Divine Intervention: reroll
activities.text: Costs 2 uses. Right after the roll, reroll any one die result (attack, damage, save, turn undead or attribute check). You can do this out of turn.

activities.name: Divine Intervention: divine might
activities.text: Costs 2 uses, as part of the action you use to attack: Advantage on all your attack rolls and double weapon damage dice until the end of your turn (flat modifiers are not doubled).

activities.name: Divine Intervention: halve damage
activities.text: Costs 2 uses, when you take damage: halve it, and all further damage you take until the start of your next turn. You can do this out of turn.

activities.name: Divine Intervention: Divine Healing
activities.text: Costs 2 uses. Completely cure all diseases, blindness, deafness, poison and mental effects caused by spells on one creature.

Channel Divinity (Charisma)|Paladin.why: Books v0.10.25 (R-B7): one Channel pool, Charisma modifier + 2 a day (minimum 3), +1 at 5th and 15th. Smite (1 use) from 1st, Turn Undead (1) 3rd, Divine Intervention (2 uses) 5th, Divine Healing its fourth option from 8th.

activities.name: Extra Action
activities.text: In the first round, take one extra action: one additional attack or half movement.

activities.name: Untouchable
activities.text: Out of turn, when an attack you can perceive would hit you, negate it as a miss. Usable Wisdom modifier times a day (minimum 1), once per round.

Quick Reflexes (Improved)|Monk.why: Extra action once per encounter (the feature's use); Untouchable's improved count is untracked here.
